steps.description:
Type categorizes the gathering (Service, Class, Meeting…) and is used to filter the attendance and giving reports.

Select a Function Type to continue.
steps.label: Function Type
steps.title: Function Type

steps.description: Tick All-Day to hide the time fields; otherwise set Start and End Time for a scheduled event.
steps.label: Timing
steps.title: Timing

steps.description: Tick Streamed when the service went out live, and Recorded when it was recorded. The Song Usage report counts these uses of each song, for your CCLI report.
steps.label: Streamed and Recorded
steps.title: Streamed and Recorded

steps.description: The order of the service. Tick Header on a row to start a part of the service, such as Worship. For a song, pick the Arrangement and leave Key empty to use its key. Displayed and Printed say how the words were copied, for CCLI. Team Notes are only for the people who serve. The bulletin never prints them.
steps.label: Service Plan
steps.title: Service Plan

steps.description: The positions this function needs and how many people each needs. Notes is a note to the people in that position. Ministry Team, Fill Open Needs asks free people from each position's list to fill the open places.
steps.label: Team Needs
steps.title: Team Needs

steps.description: Enable to expose Sign-Up Items so members can claim slots or bring items for this function from the portal.
steps.label: Volunteer Sign-Ups
steps.title: Volunteer Sign-Ups

steps.description: Turn on to make this function repeat on a schedule. Repeat Frequency, Repeat Every, the day fields, Repeat Until and Create Weeks Ahead then control which occurrences are made.
steps.label: Recurrence
steps.title: Recurrence

steps.description: Record who attended here; Attendance Total updates automatically and feeds the ministry attendance charts.
steps.label: Track Attendance
steps.title: Track Attendance
